description:
Found incidentally on 2026-08-13 while adding kovan-metrics; NOT caused by that change.

'kovan discover --root crates/kovan-metrics --kind source' prints paths like:

  crates/kovan-metrics\src\baseline.rs

The root portion keeps the forward slashes it was given, while the walked portion uses Windows backslashes. The existing e2e test crates/kovan-cli/tests/cli_e2e.rs:63 asserts the output ends with 'src/lib.rs' and therefore FAILS on Windows -- a pre-existing platform failure, currently the only failing test in kovan-cli (16 pass, 1 fails).

Why it matters beyond the test: kovan-cli is the AGENT-facing interface, and its contract is line-oriented parseable output. Mixed separators in a single path make naive downstream splitting unreliable.

Options: normalise discovery output to forward slashes on all platforms (best for an agent-facing contract, and makes the test pass as written), or make the test platform-aware (cheaper, leaves the mixed-separator output). Prefer the former.

Do NOT 'fix' this by loosening the assertion without deciding the output contract first.
title: kovan discover emits mixed path separators on Windows

acceptance_criteria: Verified against analytic mean/variance/skewness, CDF<->inverse-CDF round trip over the support, and published tabulated quantiles. Truncated variants verified to renormalise (mass integrates to 1). Methodology AND measured numbers with date recorded in the test doc comments.
description:
Implement crates/raffles/src/distributions.rs. Continuous (uniform, normal, log-normal, triangular, exponential, Weibull, gamma, beta, ...), discrete (Bernoulli, binomial, geometric, Poisson, categorical), truncated/shifted variants, and multivariate (MVN, N-D grid). Each exposes pdf/pmf, cdf, ppf (inverse CDF), support bounds, analytic mean and variance.

Upstream: ravenframework/Distributions.py, Distributions1D.py, DistributionsND.py. Each ported file needs the attribution header from crates/raffles/CLAUDE.md.

Enum dispatch (Distribution enum + ContinuousDistribution trait as a compiler-enforced contract) — no Box<dyn>, no lifetimes.

NOT here: sampling strategies (samplers module), parameter fitting, RNG.
title: raffles: distributions module

description:
Split from op-9c2e (GitHub issue #30, second comment: 'I want the pdf I'm reading to generate a bibtex entry I can copy and paste'). Depends on op-95x6 (PDF reader -- needs a notion of 'currently open PDF').

SCOPE: mostly UI wiring, not new library logic -- crates/kovan-literature/src/bibtex.rs already renders a BibTeX entry from a KovanDocument (kovan_literature::extract_metadata + bibtex::render, already exposed via the 'kovan lit bibtex' CLI command). Add a button/action in the PDF reader that runs the same extraction+render on the open PDF and shows the result in a copy-to-clipboard field.

Independent of the bibliography-window/project-folder work (op-9c2e.10-13) -- this is a single-document, no-project-folder-required action, useful on its own.

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content: Implemented: 'Generate BibTeX' button in the PDF reader toolbar (shown only when a PDF, not a plain image, is open) -- runs kovan_literature::extract_metadata + to_bibtex on the currently open PDF (the exact same pipeline kovan-cli lit bibtex already runs, no second implementation), shows the rendered entry in a read-only multiline text box with a one-click Copy button (ui.ctx().copy_text, same mechanism the digitiser's CSV preview copy button already uses). Runs synchronously on the UI thread, consistent with every other action in this GUI (matches the digitiser's own synchronous Auto-trace) -- flagged in the code comment as an easy worker-thread upgrade later if a very large scanned PDF ever makes it noticeably block, but not pre-emptively built. Verified: cargo check clean both targets, cargo test --release -p kovan clean.

title: kovan-gui: generate a BibTeX entry for the currently-open PDF, copy/paste to clipboard
